props.title: A Fortune 500 Just Found 347 AI Agents It Didn't Know It Had

props.text: Microsoft moved Agent 365 to GA on May 1 to help enterprises discover the AI agents already running across their tenants — one Fortune 500 found 347 undocumented Power Automate flows in a single scan.
Gartner's 63% number says most production agents have no governance framework at all.
Aeon is the inverse case: when the agent is a folder, every action is a commit, and the inventory is a YAML file in git, the audit happens for free.
